spanish: Y ministrará a sus hermanos en tienda de reunión para guardar guarda, y servicio no servirá; así harás a los levitas en sus guardas.

findings.issue: עבדה is a feminine cognate object and יעבד is qal imperfect 3ms, so the same masculine subject who ministers does not perform the service. «servicio no servirá» makes servicio the subject and drops that he does not serve.

notes: The rest of the verse matches person, number, cognate guarda, and the 2ms address.
